style: Synthwave neon lighting, holographic interfaces, volumetric fog. Palette of deep navy and violet with neon cyan and magenta accents.
notes: Rewrite (2026-10). All five images are kept from the 2025 page; their prompts are the originals, trimmed, kept as a record and not meant to be regenerated. The preset is the closest match to how they look, not the one they were made with.

images.prompt: Cinematic wide shot, low angle, of a futuristic naval command center. An admiral silhouetted against a towering holographic tactical display of a warship and battle grid, officers at crew stations coordinating, translucent screens, nebula light through reinforced viewports.

Dynamic overhead tactical view of a five-missile salvo striking a glowing battlefield grid, missiles with trails bursting into fireballs along a line of grid cells, glowing grid lines and heat overlays.

Close-up, tilted angle, of a sleek command console under a holographic panel showing a row of eight warship silhouettes from small corvette to huge obliterator class, targeting crosshairs on smaller screens, glowing switches.

Heroic low angle portrait of a space warship formation, a massive angular warship with glowing weapon systems dominating the foreground, smaller escorts in formation, nebula storm and distant explosions behind.
Expansive aerial view of interconnected space colonies and military outposts on a planet, nebula clouds below, patrol routes marked with glowing lines, a ringed planet in the sky.
